description: svelte-check: 'Expected 0 arguments, but got 1' at src/lib/components/CrystalBadge.svelte:21 and :32. isDarkTheme() was changed to a 0-arg function (reads themeState.theme internally, theme.svelte.ts:65) but these two call sites still pass themeState.theme. Fix: isDarkTheme(themeState.theme) -> isDarkTheme(). Note the calls are inside $effect, so reactivity is preserved (TimelineView.svelte:40 already uses the 0-arg form correctly).
title: CrystalBadge passes stale arg to 0-arg isDarkTheme
